method: Independent full-scope read-only review of the frozen source, not a diff review or reuse of prior conclusions. Manually read deployment implementation and shell entrypoints and trace positive operator workflows, transaction boundaries, rollback/recovery, permissions and durability. Parse all 115 Python files with AST and inspect test definitions, assertions and patched dependencies across the full test scope; directly read critical fixture bodies and executable probes. Review the Go program/test logic manually, and verify all four sealed Go source/lock SHA-256 values plus the six provider pins and corresponding go.sum entries; do not claim line-by-line dependency-source review, module download validation or Go execution. Review README and RECOVERY operational procedures against implementation and runbook fixture. No test suites, probe programs, instance operations, network requests, provider inference or certificate orders were executed in this review. The recorded start is the structural-evidence capture time; manual source reading began before that capture.

coverage.area: One-stop install, upgrade, initialization resume, administrator reset and restoration
coverage.inspection: Traced harness.sh, install.sh, operator/CLI commands through initialization identity reservation, protected credential publication, source binding, build-before-stop, account proof/reset, service activation and explicit recovery. Cross-checked success-path fixture assertions and failure injection.

Traced standard ACME, six integrated DNS providers, internal CA and provided PEM paths, explicit origin/port migration, retained credentials/material, TLS/SNI/chain and instance identity proof, exact service sets, diagnostics and prior-edge recovery. Renewal metadata correctly distinguishes configuration from unverified future renewal and cached-certificate readiness from DNS key access.

coverage.area: Parallel providers, catalogs and legacy configuration layers
coverage.inspection: Traced collection read/write/default/remove/profile lifecycle, scoped secrets/catalogs, responses discovery, ChatGPT/gateway/Bedrock constraints and per-provider native bindings. Confirmed legacy provider reads synthesize a default connection and migration persists it. Empty Zhipu defaults/catalogs are initialized from declared vendor metadata; no entitlement or successful paid request is claimed.

coverage.area: Managed project creation and workspace helpers
coverage.inspection: Traced native identity switching, root and ancestor handling, project publication and fsync error classification, protected descriptor-relative paths, bounded file/resource/search operations, recovery receipts, Git temporary views/index/commit CAS and worktree identity bindings. Compared adversarial and positive fixture expectations without executing them.

Traced the eight-candidate limit, exact root-owned prepared and release verification, stopped-unit/cgroup/process and mount/image exclusions, idle admission, two-lock maintenance, same-filesystem archive and recorded restoration. Failed, active, unprepared and ambiguous candidates remain retained.

Traced immutable candidate provenance, separate trusted control checkout, persistent role barriers, stop confirmation, release pointers, exact enabled/running sets, authentication and DNS compatibility guards, receipt/schema recovery and old/candidate repair. Inspected terminal replacement/fsync fault boundaries and fixture helper mechanics.

coverage.area: Archives, ownership, request spool and failure classification
coverage.inspection: Reviewed archive/manifest and dependency input bounds, stable descriptors, root/private ownership and service identities, source/import durability, request and receipt budgets, no unsafe retry after dispatch, and distinction between operator CLI errors and RPC not_sent/unknown contracts.

Reviewed same-machine recorded-uninstall maintenance, exact path inventory, retained WAL/SHM and identity material, preserved management.lock inode, quarantine and durable checkpoints, stopped verification and explicit restore-services. Reviewed runbook probe namespace guards and simulated service operations; no restore executed.

checks.result: All 115 scoped Python files parsed; 124 scoped files inventoried and covered with the methods above.
main.go, main_test.go, go.mod and go.sum match SOURCE_HASHES; all six provider module versions match go.mod and have module and go.mod hashes in go.sum.
